g.title: Orchestration
g.text: Indradhanu — agentic orchestration: who decides what, and where state and memory live
Models never write numbers: CP-SAT assigns, policy decides authority, officers decide exceptions. Each coloured boundary is enforced in code.

g.title: intake
g.text: one report at a time · stateless · the text is data, never instructions

g.title: world
g.text: single source of truth · written only in transactions · every change appends an event naming its cause

g.title: spine
g.text: _replan_loop: coalesce 1 s · one at a time

g.title: lg
g.text: one per run (thread_id = run_id) · checkpointed after every step · @contract: a node sees only its declared reads (read-only) and may return only its writes, pydantic-validated · Send nodes get a validated payload, never the state

keys: run_id · city_id · trigger · max_severity · situation[] ⊕ · shortfall · current_coverage · domain_plans[] ⊕ · attempts · proposal(Proposal) · valid · needs_officer · held · gate_reason · approval(Approval) · dispatched · outcome · trace[] ⊕ (⊕ = reducer merging parallel writes)

g.title: llm
g.text: prose and tool choice only · every call through guardrails · rules take over when no model answers
commander.run(): ReAct over read / analyse tools
step + time budget · proposals → policy gate
router → handler → tools: read · analyse · act (→ gate)

g.title: mem
g.text: ACCESS table enforced (MemoryAccessDenied) · every read, write and refusal → agent_memory_ledger
